district.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original premium architectural evidence-atlas illustration for LeakEvidence, a water utility evidence website. Single isolated axonometric cutaway of a small fictional water district with 5 limestone buildings, a water tower, curved streets, a grove of tiny trees and a deep cut earth block exposing a restrained dark mineral-green water pipe network underground. Fine graphite survey drawing, hand-engraved detail, warm limestone washes, copper pipe junction accents, finely crafted physical architectural model photographed on seamless warm ivory #F5F2EA paper. Landscape 3:2 composition. District model fills the frame, dynamic diagonal composition with generous breathing room at edges; no text, labels, UI, pins, arrows, logo or watermark. The pipes are intact, no visible leak, no damaged assets. Refined editorial illustration, believable engineering details without claiming technical drawing accuracy. Natural soft shadows; not cartoon, not futuristic, no blue gradients. This is standalone artwork, not a web page or screenshot.
district.method: OpenAI image generation; original fictional illustration
